title: URGENT: Deploy to production (https://brolabentertainment.com) - Phase 3 blocker
description:
## CRITICAL PATH BLOCKER FOR PHASE 3 CAMPAIGNS

**Status**: URGENT - Blocking all growth campaigns (BRO-124, BRO-125, BRO-126, BRO-127)

**Current Issue**:
- .env.local configured for localhost only: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000
- Production domain configured but not active: https://brolabentertainment.com (commented out)

**What needs to happen**:
1. Switch NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to https://brolabentertainment.com
2. Deploy to production (likely Vercel or hosting provider)
3. Verify signup flow works at /sign-up
4. Verify checkout flow works end-to-end
5. Confirm Clerk, Stripe, Convex are configured for production domain

**Why this is blocking**:
- Growth team cannot execute campaigns without a public signup link
- Twitter/X posts need shareable public URL
- Direct DM outreach needs clickable signup link
- Reddit comments need public URL for credibility

**Affected Tasks**:
- BRO-124: Twitter/X content (CRITICAL)
- BRO-125: Producer outreach (CRITICAL)
- BRO-126: Reddit community (HIGH)
- BRO-127: Content assets (HIGH)

**Timeline**: URGENT - Phase 3 campaign materials ready NOW, waiting for deployment

**Success Criteria**:
- Signup link publicly accessible at https://brolabentertainment.com/sign-up
- Checkout flow verified working
- All environment configs updated
- Growth team can share link and execute campaigns
